fichas.title: Boathouse and Boat Storage
fichas.summary: Boathouse planning guidance covers north-facing daylight openings, boat-carrying doors, internal storage, and an adjoining shore strip for boat preparation, water taps, and trailer parking. Nearby lawn or woodland may support camping.

fichas.title: Indoor Rowing Basin and Double-Sided Sculling Pool
fichas.summary: A training rowing basin uses shortened oars and water circulation to create currents similar to open water. The text recommends combining the facility with a sports hall or indoor pool and their changing rooms. An accompanying plan and section depict a double-sided sculling pool with compensating channels.
